notes: Read by an external reader (Meta Muse) from a written spec (/mnt/project-files/muse-permit-appeals/prompt.md) over the volume's Internet Archive OCR text, minutesofmeeting1975sanf; converted here, page-located in the hOCR, quotations and street numbers checked against the OCR, and resolved here. Personal names were removed from every field on conversion.

coverage.note: 1975-01-06 to 1975-12-30. Read whole, first meeting to last: 40 regular meetings (Jan 6, 13, 20, 27; Feb 3, 10, 24; Mar 3, 10, 17, 24; Apr 7, 14, 21, 28; May 5, 19; Jun 9, 16, 23, 30; Jul 14, 21, 28; Aug 11, 18, 25; Sep 15, 22; Oct 6, 20, 27; Nov 3, 17, 24; Dec 1, 8, 15, 22, 29) plus 37 special site-inspection blocks. No minutes in the scan for Mar 31, May 26, Jun 2, Jul 7, Sep 1, Sep 8, Sep 29 or Nov 10, 1975, though each is referenced in minutes that are in the scan. The September 22 regular meeting minutes appear twice in the scan (duplicated pages with differing OCR of appeal numbers) and are counted once. Appeal numbers are plain four-digit numbers (e.g. 7084), variances V-7089, unlike the 1980s 75-315 pattern. Heading/body date conflicts: Jan 6 (body says Dec 30, 1975), Feb 10 (heading 1973), Oct 6 (body Oct 2), Nov 17 (body Dec 17), Dec 8 (heading Dec 3), Dec 30 (heading 1973); heading dates used throughout. The OCR frequently misreads 73xx as 75xx; numbers were corrected only where cross-referenced in other meetings (7317, 7318, 7324, 7315, V-7329, 7372, 7367, 7337, V-7338) or by numerical sequence, each with a reader note. Duplicate appeal numbers recorded as printed: 7125, 7285, 7335, 7339, 7345, 7364; 7351 was decided Oct 6 for 525 Baker Street yet the Oct 20 minutes say 7351 was continued, and no row is recorded for that continuance. Conflicts recorded as printed: 7132 overruled 3-1 with four commissioners present; 7255; the V-7383 vote printed as 5 to 2 with five commissioners present and two voting to overrule, read as 3-2, the only possible count; the Sep 15 rehearing printed as 7201 read as 7281; the two copies of the Sep 22 minutes disagree on the continued and withdrawn appeal numbers (7325/7525, 7312/7512). Skipped per the standing rules: peddler, street-artist, taxicab, jitney, driver-vehicle, loudspeaker-vehicle and mobile-caterer appeals with no fixed premises; encounter-studio employee permits 7360 and 7361 with no address; an outcall massage permit 7325 with no address; appeals whose subject or address is never stated anywhere in the volume (7123, 7368, 7390, 7322, 7349, 7325/7525, 7512/7312, 7526, 7333, 7389, and rehearing requests with no identifiable subject: 7362, 7365, 7366, 7233, 7386, and the Sep 15 rehearing denials printed as 7385 and 7351); and the Fulton Street appeal of Dec 1 whose number is not printed, possibly 7389 or 7390. Open threads into 1976: 7154 (1130 Silliman), 7238, 7186 (899 North Point), 7340 (238-248 Myrtle), 7301 (40 Cedar Alley,
